product_metadata.title: Air Fryer & Pressure Cooker Magnetic Cheat Sheet Set, Air Fryer Accessories Cook Times, Instapot Accessory Magnet Sheet Quick Reference Guide for Cooking and Frying (Bundle)
features: 🧲 Quality Kitchen Gadgets : Big and clear font along with the most popular foods is provided on the small magnet. Bonus, double-sided tape included, so you can stick these waterproof and oil-proof magnetic cheat sheets safely on your air fryer or cooker for always convenient access.

🏷️ Classified & labeled : We designed a big and a small magnetic cheat sheet for air fryers and instapot to help you spend less time cooking and more time enjoying the food you love. They feature clear and easy to read letters showing a wide variety of food including meats, veggies, frozen foods, etc. along with cooking times, size, temps, and, more. We used even larger font for the small magnet along with the most popular foods for even easier and quick referencing.

💪 Wide compatibility : These air fryer / instant pot accessories are compatible with Ninja Air Fryer, Instant Vortex Air Fryer, Cosori Air Fryer Max, Prestige Pressure Cooker, Presto Pressure Cooker, Ninja Foodi Grill, and many more to make your time in the kitchen simpler.

🎁 Makes a perfect gift : Our pressure cooker and air fryer quick reference guide sheets make the perfect gift for friends and family to help them prepare delicious meals the simple way. This pack makes the ideal gift for Christmas, Birthdays, New Year’s, Thanksgiving, and any other occasion
